<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 182.0732 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 181.0659 Da. The formula C₁₃H₉O matches this mass (exact mass 181.06534 Da, within typical MS tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C13H9O.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H9O</final_answer>
